summary: Ebang International Holdings Inc. filed a Form 6-K on June 11, 2026, announcing its subsidiary won a bid for industrial land in Inner Mongolia, China, for an amorphous and nanocrystalline new materials project. Terms include the land acquisition price, which is not disclosed. The board recommends the project as a strategic expansion into renewable energy and new materials. Structural notes involve the subsidiary's bid and plans for production facilities compliant with U.S. DOE standards. Watch for further details on land cost, financing, and timeline; no arbitrage angle given real asset nature.
